summary: Roseau County tower listed as standing by FFLA with no build date or staffing record; a 2008 state list has an unmatched 'River' tower built 1928.

evidence.supports: tower in Roseau County at the FFLA coordinates, listed as standing
a fire tower whose only location name is River, built 1928, appears on the 2008 state list
that entry is scheduled for disposal with an estimated value of $100
the 2008 state list includes Forestry fire towers
evidence.quote: Forestry has 14 Fire Towers that are under utilized and need to be reviewed.

evidence.supports: the Roseau River Wildlife Management Area is built around a 27-mile dike system
evidence.quote: The centerpiece is a 27-mile long dike system.

notes_for_editor: The 2008 state list has a fire tower whose only location name is 'River' (built 1928, scheduled for disposal). The list has no county or coordinate column, so it may or may not be this tower; it is mentioned in the story as unmatched. The FFLA coordinates were not checked against WMA boundaries. The DNR WMA page does not mention a fire tower. Records to check: Roseau County Historical Society, Minnesota DNR Forestry. No photos found.
